title: Can ChatGPT or Claude make videos?
summary: ChatGPT can't generate video since Sora shut down, and Claude Motion makes animations only. Here's how you make videos in 2026
body_markdown:
TL;DR


- ChatGPT doesn't generate video in November 2026. Sora's app and website closed on April 26, 2026, and any video made in ChatGPT now comes from a third-party plugin.
- Claude has no video model either. Claude Motion (beta, Team and Enterprise) builds animations from code and exports them as MP4, with no realistic footage or people.
- A work video needs your real product on screen, narration that matches it, your brand, and updates after every release. A chat window doesn't give you those.
- Connect a video platform through MCP and the assistant builds and edits the real video. The Clueso MCP works with Claude and ChatGPT on every Clueso plan, including Free.


ChatGPT can't make a video file in November 2026. OpenAI shut down the Sora app and website on April 26, 2026. ChatGPT itself generates text, still images, and short looping GIFs, so a request for a product video comes back as a script and a shot list.


Claude gets further. On Team and Enterprise plans, Claude Motion turns a prompt into a short animation you can download as an MP4.


Buyers ask us a version of this on sales calls: why pay for a video tool when the team already has Claude or ChatGPT? Both assistants plan a work video well. On their own, neither can record your product or update a video after the next release, and those are the jobs that keep training and launch videos stuck in a backlog. Connect either one to a video platform through MCP and the same chat can build the video and change it when you ask.


## Can ChatGPT make videos?


No. ChatGPT can't generate a video file on its own as of November 2026. OpenAI[discontinued the Sora web and app experiences](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001152-what-to-know-about-the-sora-discontinuation) on April 26, 2026 and the Sora API on September 24, 2026. ChatGPT now generates text, still images, and short looping GIFs, and it makes video only through third-party plugins that run on another company's model and account.


Those plugins are why you'll still see videos made "in ChatGPT". ChatGPT's Plugin Directory, which[replaced the App Directory on July 9, 2026](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-release-notes) , lists video plugins that generate short clips from a prompt or edit footage you upload. Each one runs on its vendor's own video model and bills through that vendor's account, so the video comes from the plugin's company rather than from OpenAI. Your workspace admin and your ChatGPT plan decide which plugins you can add.


Without a plugin, ChatGPT still handles the planning half well. Paste in the release notes or the PRD and it writes a script with scene breaks, then draws storyboard frames with ChatGPT Images. Our guide to[making a product video with Claude or ChatGPT](https://www.clueso.io/blog/claude-chatgpt-product-video) walks through that route step by step, and the route where the assistant builds the video itself.


## Can Claude make videos?


Partly. Claude has no video generation model, so it can't produce realistic footage or people. On Team and Enterprise plans, Claude Motion, in beta since October 2026, writes code that animates text, charts, shapes, and images, and exports the result as an MP4. On every Claude plan, Claude can also drive a video tool through a connector.


Anthropic describes[Claude Motion](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/17454997-get-started-with-claude-motion) as built for explaining your own work, and it suits a chart that animates into place or a concept diagram for an internal update. You change it by asking Claude ("slow down the second scene") or in its editor, then download the MP4. Anthropic's documentation for it doesn't mention narration or a soundtrack, and since it builds animations from code, it doesn't record your product.


Developers have one more route. Claude Code, like OpenAI's Codex, can write video code in a framework such as Remotion and render it to an MP4 on your machine. That works for motion graphics if someone on the team is comfortable reviewing code.

## What does a work video need that a chat window can't give you?


A launch video or a training video has a different job from a social clip. It has to show your real product, with narration that matches each click, and it has to stay right after you ship. Redesign the sidebar and every video that shows the old one is now teaching a screen nobody can find. The table below sets each requirement against what a chat window gives you.

## How do you get a finished work video out of ChatGPT or Claude?


Connect the assistant to a video platform through MCP. Model Context Protocol is an open standard that lets an AI assistant call actions inside another tool, so the assistant decides what to build and the video platform renders it. Our explainer on[what a video MCP server actually does](https://www.clueso.io/blog/video-mcp-server-what-to-check) covers what to check before you connect one.


At Clueso, we built the[Clueso MCP](https://www.clueso.io/mcp) for this. You add it to Claude as a custom connector or to ChatGPT as a plugin (it also works with Gemini, Codex, and Cursor), then describe the video. In ChatGPT, adding a custom MCP server is a Business, Enterprise, or Edu workspace feature, so check your plan before you set it up. Hand over what you have: a prompt, a script, a PDF or slide deck, screenshots, a URL, or a[screen recording](https://www.clueso.io/features/screen-recorder) .


The assistant builds a Clueso project from that material. It writes the narration, generates[AI voiceover](https://www.clueso.io/features/ai-voiceovers) synced to the screen, adds zooms and callouts, and pulls in[motion graphics](https://www.clueso.io/features/motion-graphics) where an idea is clearer animated than recorded. It can also edit videos you already have, swapping assets, updating text, or changing the branding across 3 videos or 300 with one instruction.


The result is an ordinary Clueso project, so nothing is trapped in the chat. A teammate can open it on the timeline and adjust a cut by hand, or you can ask the assistant to rewrite one line of narration without rebuilding the rest.


Brand settings and[Clueprints](https://www.clueso.io/clueprints) keep every video in the same style. Exports go out as an MP4 or as an[embed that updates in place](https://www.clueso.io/features/embed-videos-anywhere) each time you republish, and the same project produces a[step-by-step guide](https://www.clueso.io/documentation) for a help center Clueso hosts or the one you already run.[Translation into 150+ languages](https://www.clueso.io/features/auto-translate) is on every plan, and[SCORM export](https://www.clueso.io/features/scorm-export) for your LMS is on Enterprise.


The Clueso MCP is on[every plan, Free included](https://www.clueso.io/pricing) . On Enterprise,[Clueso Agents](https://www.clueso.io/agents) can record your product too, which takes the recording step off your list.


Teamworks' customer education team works this way. Most of its videos now start in Claude through the Clueso MCP, and each one takes 20–30 minutes, down from 4–5 hours ([how Teamworks scales videos for 20+ products](https://www.clueso.io/customers/teamworks) ). Across Clueso, 628 people built videos from Claude on the web or desktop and 459 from ChatGPT in the 90 days we measured in our[study of 45,000 new videos](https://www.clueso.io/blog/ai-agent-video-study) .


For the connection steps and five prompts that build a feature release video, see[how to use Claude or ChatGPT to create a product video](https://www.clueso.io/blog/claude-chatgpt-product-video) .

## Frequently asked questions


### Is Sora still available in ChatGPT?


No. OpenAI discontinued the Sora web and app experiences on April 26, 2026 and the Sora API on September 24, 2026. In September 2026,[OpenAI support told users](https://community.openai.com/t/full-video-generation-inside-chatgpt/1391602/2) it would pass along requests for video creation inside ChatGPT and had no timeline to share.


### Can ChatGPT turn an image into a video?


Only into a short looping GIF.[GIF creation started rolling out in ChatGPT](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-release-notes) on November 4, 2026, so you can upload a sketch and ask ChatGPT to animate it, but the result is a silent loop rather than a video file. A clip with sound needs a third-party video plugin, which runs on its vendor's model and account. For a work video, the Clueso MCP can take your screenshots and a script and build a narrated video from them in your Clueso workspace.


### Can Claude generate videos for free?


Claude Motion isn't on the Free plan; it's in beta on Team and Enterprise. A Free Claude account can[add one custom connector](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11175166-get-started-with-custom-connectors-using-remote-mcp) , though. The Clueso MCP works on Clueso's Free plan, which includes 1,000 one-time AI credits and 10 minutes of video exports a month.


### Can ChatGPT or Claude make motion graphics for a product launch video?


Claude Motion animates text, charts, shapes, and images into a short MP4 on Team and Enterprise. For a narrated launch video that cuts between your product and motion graphics, connect a video platform. Clueso generates[motion graphics](https://www.clueso.io/features/motion-graphics) inside the video from a prompt, at a Basic level on Free and Solo and Advanced on Business and Enterprise.


### Does a ChatGPT or Claude subscription pay for the video tool?


No, your assistant subscription pays for the assistant. When it builds a video through the Clueso MCP, the work happens in your Clueso workspace and draws on your Clueso plan's AI credits. Creating and editing videos by chat use credits, while AI voiceover and step-by-step guides don't. Free includes 1,000 credits once, and Solo includes 2,500 a month ([pricing](https://www.clueso.io/pricing) ).


Take the brief for the next video on your list and run it twice. Paste it into ChatGPT or Claude as a plain chat, then paste it again with the Clueso MCP connected. Hold both results against the second table above and count the rows the plain chat left for you to do by hand.
